data.name: tripo3d/p2/image-to-3d
data.description: Tripo P2 Image-to-3D generates a 3D mesh with optional PBR textures, selectable texture quality and triangle or quad topology.

auto_size.description: Auto-scale the model to real-world dimensions in meters.

delight.description: Remove baked-in lighting before texturing with v3.5-20260815.

export_orientation.description: Optional forward axis for the exported model.

export_uv.description: Generate UV coordinates for the model.

face_limit.description: Optional mesh face limit, 48 to 50000. When quad is true, use at most 25000 faces. Omit for adaptive face count.

image.description: Input image URL for 3D model creation.

model_seed.description: Optional seed for geometry generation reproducibility.

pbr.description: Generate PBR material maps. Enabling PBR also enables textures and texture billing.

quad.description: Generate quad rather than triangle topology. Maximum 25000 faces; no additional charge.

texture.description: Generate textures. Disable both texture and pbr for untextured pricing.

texture_quality.description: Texture quality. Fast requires texture_version v3.5-20260815.

texture_seed.description: Optional seed for texture generation reproducibility.

texture_version.description: Optional texture model version. Select v3.5-20260815 when using fast quality.

data.name: tripo3d/h3.1/image-to-3d
data.description: Tripo3D H3.1 Image-to-3D converts a single image into high-quality 3D models with textures and PBR materials.

auto_size.description: Auto-scale the model to real-world dimensions.

face_limit.description: Target number of faces for the generated mesh. If not set, the model adaptively determines the count.

image.description: URL of the input image for 3D model creation.

orientation.description: Model orientation. 'align_image' auto-rotates to match the input image.

pbr.description: Whether to generate PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials. If true, texture is also enabled.

quad.description: Generate quad (4-sided) mesh topology instead of triangles.

texture.description: Whether to generate textures for the model.

texture_alignment.description: How textures are aligned. 'original_image' aligns to input image, 'geometry' aligns to generated geometry.

texture_quality.description: Quality level for textures. 'detailed' produces higher-resolution textures.

data.name: tripo3d/h3.1/multiview-to-3d
data.description: Tripo3D H3.1 Multiview-to-3D generates high-quality 3D models from 2-4 multi-angle images with textures and PBR materials.

auto_size.description: Auto-scale the model to real-world dimensions.

face_limit.description: Target number of faces for the generated mesh. If not set, the model adaptively determines the count.

images.description: 2 to 4 image URLs of the same object from different angles. Order: [front, left, back, right]. Front view is required.

orientation.description: Model orientation. 'align_image' auto-rotates to match the input image.

pbr.description: Whether to generate PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials. If true, texture is also enabled.

quad.description: Generate quad (4-sided) mesh topology instead of triangles.

texture.description: Whether to generate textures for the model.

texture_alignment.description: How textures are aligned. 'original_image' aligns to input image, 'geometry' aligns to generated geometry.

texture_quality.description: Quality level for textures. 'detailed' produces higher-resolution textures.

data.name: meshy/v6/image-to-3d
data.description: Meshy 6 Preview converts 2D images into high-quality 3D models with accurate geometry reconstruction and superior texture quality.

image.description: Image URL or base64 data URI for 3D model creation. Supports .jpg, .jpeg, and .png formats.

should_remesh.description: Enable remesh phase for cleaner topology

symmetry_mode.description: Controls symmetry behavior of the generated model

ta_pose.description: Generate model in A/T pose for rigging

target_polycount.description: Target polygon count in generated model

texture_prompt.description: Text prompt to guide texturing process

topology.description: Specify the topology of the generated model. Quad for smooth surfaces, Triangle for detailed geometry.

data.name: meshy/v7.1/image-to-3d
data.description: Meshy 7.1 converts one reference image into a textured, PBR-ready 3D mesh with up to 4K geometry resolution and downloadable GLB, FBX, OBJ, and USDZ files.

animation_action_id.description: Meshy animation preset ID, used only when animation is enabled.

enable_animation.description: Apply an animation preset. Requires enable_rigging.

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR maps in addition to the base color texture.

enable_rigging.description: Automatically rig a humanoid character, including basic walking and running animations.

geometry_resolution.description: Geometry resolution. `standard` is the default; `2k`/`4k` generate denser, finer surface detail (up to 4K) at extra cost. Only applies to `standard` geometry.

model_type.description: Geometry mode: `standard` for a detailed mesh, `lowpoly` for cleaner low-polygon geometry, or `smart-topology` for optimized production topology.

pose_mode.description: Optional humanoid pose. Leave unselected for no specific pose.

rigging_height_meters.description: Approximate character height in meters when rigging is enabled.

target_polycount.description: Target number of polygons for standard remeshed output.

texture_image.description: Optional image to guide texture generation.

texture_prompt.description: Optional text guidance for texture generation.

topology.description: Mesh topology. This setting is ignored when model_type is lowpoly.

data.name: meshy/v7.1/multi-image-to-3d
data.description: Meshy 7.1 reconstructs a textured, PBR-ready 3D mesh from one to four views of the same object, with 2K geometry resolution.

animation_action_id.description: Meshy animation preset ID, used only when animation is enabled.

enable_animation.description: Apply an animation preset. Requires enable_rigging.

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR maps in addition to the base color texture.

enable_rigging.description: Automatically rig a humanoid character, including basic walking and running animations.

geometry_resolution.description: Geometry resolution. `standard` is the default; `2k` generate denser, finer surface detail (up to 2K) at extra cost. Only applies to `standard` geometry.

images.description: One to four images of the same object from different angles.

pose_mode.description: Optional humanoid pose. Leave unselected for no specific pose.

rigging_height_meters.description: Approximate character height in meters when rigging is enabled.

target_polycount.description: Target number of polygons for remeshed output.

texture_image.description: Optional image to guide texture generation.

texture_prompt.description: Optional text guidance for texture generation.

topology.description: Mesh topology for the generated model.

data.name: hyper3d/rodin-v2.5/image-to-3d
data.description: Hyper3D Rodin v2.5 turns reference images into production-ready 3D assets with clean meshes, UVs, and textures.

addons.description: Optional HighPack add-on for 4K textures and higher-poly geometry.

geometry_instruct_mode.description: Faithful follows the input closely; creative allows more variation.

images.description: Reference images for generating the 3D model. Up to 5 images are allowed.

is_micro.description: Generate finer micro-scale geometric detail. Only effective with Extreme-High tier.

preview_render.description: Generate a preview render image of the 3D model.

prompt.description: Optional text prompt. If empty, the model auto-generates a prompt from the images.

quality_and_mesh.description: Combined quality and mesh type selection.

ta_pose.description: Generate characters in T-pose or A-pose format.
ta_pose.title: T/A Pose

texture_delight.description: Remove baked lighting and highlights from generated textures.

texture_mode.description: Texture generation quality. Leave empty to use the model default.

tier.description: Generation tier. Extreme-High bills at double the base rate.

use_original_alpha.description: Preserve the transparency channel from input images.

data.name: wavespeed-ai/trellis-2/image-to-3d
data.description: TRELLIS.2 turns a single image into a textured 3D GLB with PBR materials.

image.description: Single input image URL, data URI or base64 image.

remove_background.description: Remove the image background before generation. Disable to use existing image alpha.

resolution.description: Geometry resolution. Higher resolution takes more time and memory.

seed.description: Random seed. Use -1 for a random seed.

target_face_count.description: Target mesh face count after simplification. The final count is approximate.

data.name: wavespeed-ai/hunyuan3d-v3/image-to-3d
data.description: Transform your photos into ultra-high-resolution 3D models in seconds with Tencent's Hunyuan3D V3. Film-quality geometry with PBR textures from single or multi-view images, ready for games, e-commerce, and 3D printing. Ready-to-use REST inference API, best performance, no coldstarts, affordable pricing.

back_image.description: Optional back view image URL for better 3D reconstruction.

enable_pbr.description: Whether to enable PBR material generation

generate_type.description: Generation type. Normal: textured model. LowPoly: polygon reduction. Geometry: white model without texture.

image.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

left_image.description: Optional left view image URL for better 3D reconstruction.

polygon_type.description: Polygon type. Only takes effect when GenerateType is LowPoly.

right_image.description: Optional right view image URL for better 3D reconstruction.

data.name: wavespeed-ai/hunyuan-3d-v3.1/image-to-3d-rapid
data.description: Hunyuan 3D V3.1 Rapid image-to-3D generation model. Ready-to-use REST inference API, best performance, no cold starts, affordable pricing.

image.description: Front view image of the object to convert into a 3D model (128-5000px, max 8MB, JPG/PNG/WEBP)
